rationale: Select the first-ranked feasible method, data-parallel over inputs. All three ranked methods share the measured single-GPU concurrent whole-workload throughput bound of 1.7757420117837561x; this method preserves the supplied ranking. Its k is min(8, 1.7757420117837561), with MPS enabled, and p=1 covers the whole workload rather than kernels alone. Kernels account for 57.83410528695158% of wall time and CUDA API host time for 41.769027520039115%; concurrent independent jobs can overlap host submission and GPU work. GPU utilization is unavailable, so no utilization claim is inferred. H2D plus D2H transfers account for only 0.3968671930093078%, consistent with the supplied pipelining bound of 1.001988281383304x. Only one GPU is available. The sealed sample has one input and eight independent seeds, so distribute existing input-seed jobs without splitting a dependent trajectory, adding inputs, or changing the scientific workload. The concurrency factor is a measured throughput bound, not an integer worker count or a guaranteed realized speedup.
plan_steps: During later implementation, locate the existing sequential driver and reporting path; retain the selected data-parallel over inputs method and all sealed scientific settings. Validate later against sequential baseline using identical input, seed, steps, and energy-query schedule. Aggregate any repeated observations within each seed by median before inference; the eight seeds remain eight scientific units, never forty independent samples. For each metric, calculate the eight method-minus-baseline seed-level differences and use their minimum and maximum as the finite two-sided exact confidence interval for the paired median at Bonferroni per-metric alpha=0.025, preserving the sealed joint confidence requirement of 0.95.

Require both confidence intervals to lie strictly inside their symmetric absolute margins: (-38.64603707668355, 38.64603707668355) kJ/mol for mean_potential_kj_mol and (-103.46065670609076, 103.46065670609076) kJ/mol for final_potential_kj_mol. Do not substitute bitwise equality or zero tolerance. Keep all eight seeds and margins fixed; do not add seeds or enlarge margins after observing candidates.

Measure later end-to-end completion time for the same complete input-seed workload on one GPU, including orchestration and collection overhead, against sequential execution at equal GPU-second cost. Report observed throughput separately from the supplied 1.7757420117837561x bound. Accept only if sealed equivalence passes and end-to-end throughput improves; otherwise report failure or inconclusive equivalence without changing method or protocol. No implementation or workloads are performed for this proposal.

Margins are prospective scientific resolutions derived from baseline ensemble MCSE across eight independent seeds, not same-seed repeat variability or published acceptance tolerances. Conditional joint power lower bound 0.957209244745072 assumes independent seed-level differences with median zero and normally distributed paired differences whose SD is at most margin/3 for each metric; paired variability has not been measured. Unconditional power is unknown, and equivalence may remain inconclusive. Do not alter margins, seeds, confidence rule, or sampling protocol in response.
